5c3b2fb2.text: Satisfied that the small world had been ordered and that their work was done, the Titans prepared to leave Azeroth. However, before they departed, they charged the greatest species of the world with the task of watching over Kalimdor, lest any force should threaten its perfect tranquility. In that age, there were many dragonflights.
5c3b2fb2.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

10781|cb1093ae.name: Royal Overseer Bauhaus
10781|cb1093ae.text: I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

14727|5457bc8c.name: Vehena
14727|5457bc8c.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the Darkspear, then you can start by donating valuable resources for those in need!  Textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know.

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the Darkspear!

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2238|6d472bad.name: Tog'thar
2238|6d472bad.text: Get away from here, $c, or they'll put you in chains as well.

2239|4513b5ec.name: Drull
2239|4513b5ec.text: Do you mock me while I am unable to defend myself, bound to this ball of iron?

2239|7c058ec5.name: Drull
2239|7c058ec5.text: One of the humans has the key to this infernal contraption. Eston I think they said his name was.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2399|728032b3.name: Daryl Stack
2399|728032b3.text: Who sent you here? You're not ready for my instruction yet! You'll be told when you're ready.

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

3296|10e6748a.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|10e6748a.text: Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3296|bb16f568.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|bb16f568.text: You want Zamja at Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag.  Go up the stairs on the left as you enter The Drag from the Valley of Strength.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4564|db7f8bbb.name: Luther Pickman
4564|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4613|c46004b8.name: Christopher Drakul
4613|c46004b8.text: Welcome to the Undercity Guild Registry. What do you want?

5624|0c7d0821.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|0c7d0821.text: Lady stitch us up and bandage when we get hit.  You find her in inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5624|41ebb2bb.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|41ebb2bb.text: Eunice Burch sell leftover parts.  You find her in Trade Quarter.

5753|721fd095.name: Martha Strain
5753|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7166|912c996a.name: Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus
7166|912c996a.text: The machine comes alive at your touch.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

1069-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

1483-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1483-accept.text:
The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.

A while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.

Maybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
1483-accept.title: Ziz Fizziks

235-accept.name: Warcaller Gorlach
235-accept.text:
Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
235-accept.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

235-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
235-complete.text:
Welcome to the new frontier, $N.  Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young $c like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle.  Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.

Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt.  Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.
235-complete.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

25-accept.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-accept.text:
If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

You up for being useful?
25-accept.title: Stonetalon Standstill

25-complete.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-complete.text:
Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens.  From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends.  Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...

Looks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it.  Take this - you've earned it.
25-complete.title: Stonetalon Standstill

498-complete.name: Krusk
498-complete.text:
So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!

It would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...

When we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.
498-complete.title: The Rescue

502-complete.name: Stanley
502-complete.text: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
502-complete.title: Elixir of Pain

527-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-complete.text: At ease, $c.  I see you have returned from battle.  My sources tell me you performed well on the Hillsbrad front.
527-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-accept.text:
Word of the attack on the northern farms has the townsfolk panicked.  Most excellent.

Our Deathstalkers report peasants fleeing to the fields in southern Hillsbrad.  The fools think they can hide in the orchards and escape their doom.

Prove them wrong, $N.  Return to Hillsbrad Fields and seek out the cowering peasants.  Lay waste to them in the name of our Dark Lady.

Dismissed!
528-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-complete.text: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad.  The battle goes well.
528-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-accept.text:
The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance.  The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith.  We need to shut down all supply lines.

Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan.  Slay his apprentices as well.  While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile.  The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
529-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-complete.text: Mission accomplished, $c.  And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
529-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-accept.text:
The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall.  We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting.  We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council.  Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation.  And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
532-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

546-accept.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-accept.text:
I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad.  So jealous I am. . .

While you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

Perhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself?  You see I am collecting human skulls.  And you will be fighting humans for quite some time.  Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
546-accept.title: Souvenirs of Death

546-complete.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-complete.text: Precious skulls!  So beautiful!  I owe you as promised, $N!
546-complete.title: Souvenirs of Death

546-progress.name: Deathguard Samsa
546-progress.text:
So the lucky $N returns?  How many humans have you slaughtered today?  Hundreds I do hope!

Have you any skulls for me?
546-progress.title: Souvenirs of Death

549-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
549-complete.text: Excellent, $c. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
549-complete.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

6383-complete.name: Senani Thunderheart
6383-complete.text:
There are three legendary creatures that make up the Ashenvale Hunt; you may seek them and test yourself against their cunning and might.  In the process, you will hopefully learn something about yourself.  The creatures are: the bear Ursangous, the nightsaber cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon.

The creatures of the Ashenvale Hunt are powerful, and you may find that you'll need aid in bringing them down.  If you should best them, bring me proof of your deed.
6383-complete.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

6441-accept.name: Pixel
6441-accept.text:
Heya! I've been traveling through Ashenvale, heading towards Ratchet, and decided to make a stop here at Splintertree. I'm always looking for an opportunity, and it seems that satyr horns are in high demand in Ratchet these days.

After asking around here, it seems that the satyrs in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian all have the type of horns I am looking for. I'm no match for those satyrs... but you look like you might be!

Tell you what, you collect the horns for me and I'll make it worth your time.
6441-accept.title: Satyr Horns

6503-accept.name: Kuray'bin
6503-accept.text:
We received reports that Ashenvale outrunners left Silverwing Outpost not long ago, and now sneak near our territories in the forest.  We don't want them gathering intelligence on our defenses!

Sneak through the forests south of our post here and east of the Alliance outpost of Silverwing.  Find and slay the outrunners, then return to me.
6503-accept.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6503-complete.name: Kuray'bin
6503-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  Your hunting skills are impressive...

The loss of those outrunners helps blind the Alliance, and when they lack intelligence they are less likely to launch attacks.
6503-complete.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

6504-accept.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-accept.text:
I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover.

The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
6504-accept.title: The Lost Pages

6504-progress.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-progress.text: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
6504-progress.title: The Lost Pages

6544-accept.name: Torek
6544-accept.text:
Hey!  $C!  Come here!

My raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west.  Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire.  Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors.  The battle will be glorious!

Do you want to share in the glory, $N, and aid us?  If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.

What do you say.  Are you with us?
6544-accept.title: Torek's Assault

6544-complete.name: Ertog Ragetusk
6544-complete.text:
So Torek's attack was successful!  Well done, $N.  Night elves are decent foes.  A little skinny, but strong and fierce!  I'm sure the battle was something to see...

And I hope you gained a scar or two!
6544-complete.title: Torek's Assault

6546-complete.name: Warsong Outrider
6546-complete.text: Take my update to Kadrak. Swiftly, $N.
6546-complete.title: Warsong Outrider Update

6546-progress.name: Warsong Outrider
6546-progress.text:
Much danger lies along this path, $N. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near.

We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale.  I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara.

It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, $N.
6546-progress.title: Warsong Outrider Update

6547-complete.name: Warsong Scout
6547-complete.text: Let Kadrak know of the success we have had here holding off the night elves. Our plans are going well.
6547-complete.title: Warsong Scout Update

6547-progress.name: Warsong Scout
6547-progress.text:
Keep an eye out, $r. The elves are often hiding in the shadows...

We must always be watching. We have worked very hard to claim this land, and the elves are looking for a chance to take it from us.

I assume you have my next orders from Kadrak?
6547-progress.title: Warsong Scout Update

65593-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
65593-complete.text:
As expected. Excellently done, $N.

<Carendin holds one heart in each hand, then gently brings them together.>

Idiots.
65593-complete.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65593-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
65593-progress.text: Ah, $N, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?
65593-progress.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65597-accept.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-accept.text:
The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.

The demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, $N. You must subdue it fully.

Only then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
65597-accept.title: The Binding

65597-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-complete.text:
Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a $c has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.

This trial did not break you, $N, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.
65597-complete.title: The Binding

65597-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-progress.text:
The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.

Do not let it, $N.
65597-progress.title: The Binding

6571-accept.name: Locke Okarr
6571-accept.text:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?
6571-accept.title: Warsong Supplies

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

7833-progress.name: Vehena
7833-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7833-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

891-accept.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-accept.text:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
891-accept.title: The Guns of Northwatch

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

94223-accept.name: Unknown
94223-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94223-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Silver Skeleton Key

959-accept.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
